title: mentha candicans f. angustifolia
intro: Mentha candicans f. angustifolia, commonly known as Mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce nausea, and alleviate headaches. The therapeutic actions of Mentha candicans f. angustifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and relieve stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
